Exercise 5.1: Temperature Data (DWD)¶

Analysis of temperature measurements from the Deutscher Wetterdienst (DWD) across 80 stations in Germany (1781–2024).

In [3]:
%pip install seaborn -qqq

Note: you may need to restart the kernel to use updated packages.
In [4]:
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.ticker as mticker
import seaborn as sns
from scipy import stats

plt.rcParams['figure.dpi'] = 120
plt.rcParams['font.size'] = 11
sns.set_theme(style='whitegrid', palette='muted')

MONTH_NAMES = ['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun',
               'Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec']

Task 1 – Import & Clean Data¶

In [5]:
# ----- load -----
df = pd.read_csv('temperature_data_processed.csv',
                 dtype={'stationid': int, 'date': str, 'time': int, 'temp': float})

# ----- parse date -----
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'], format='%Y%m%d')
df['year']  = df['date'].dt.year
df['month'] = df['date'].dt.month
df['day']   = df['date'].dt.day

# ----- remove missing values -----
before = len(df)
df = df[df['temp'] != -999].copy()
after  = len(df)

print(f"Rows before cleaning : {before:,}")
print(f"Rows removed (-999)  : {before - after:,}")
print(f"Rows after cleaning  : {after:,}")
df.head()

Task 2 – Active Stations per Year¶

In [6]:
stations_per_year = (
    df.groupby('year')['stationid']
      .nunique()
      .rename('n_stations')
      .reset_index()
)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(14, 4))
ax.fill_between(stations_per_year['year'], stations_per_year['n_stations'],
                alpha=0.35, color='steelblue')
ax.plot(stations_per_year['year'], stations_per_year['n_stations'],
        color='steelblue', linewidth=1.4)
ax.set_xlabel('Year')
ax.set_ylabel('Number of active stations')
ax.set_title('Number of Stations Contributing Measurements per Year')
ax.set_xlim(stations_per_year['year'].min(), stations_per_year['year'].max())
ax.yaxis.set_major_locator(mticker.MaxNLocator(integer=True))
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('stations_per_year.png', bbox_inches='tight')
plt.show()

Task 4 – Filter Data¶

In [8]:
mask = (
    df['stationid'].isin(reference_stations) &
    df['year'].between(1960, 2020) &
    df['time'].isin([12, 14])
)

df_filtered = df[mask].copy()

print(f"Rows in filtered dataset: {len(df_filtered):,}")
print(f"Unique stations        : {df_filtered['stationid'].nunique()}")
print(f"Year range             : {df_filtered['year'].min()} – {df_filtered['year'].max()}")

Task 5 – Measurements at Time 12 vs 14 per Year¶

In [9]:
counts_by_time = (
    df_filtered.groupby(['year', 'time'])
               .size()
               .unstack(level='time')
               .rename(columns={12: 'Time 12', 14: 'Time 14'})
               .fillna(0)
               .astype(int)
)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(14, 4))
counts_by_time.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax, width=0.75,
                    color=['#2196F3', '#FF9800'], edgecolor='none')
ax.set_xlabel('Year')
ax.set_ylabel('Number of measurements')
ax.set_title('Measurements Available at Time 12 and 14 per Year')
ax.legend(title='Measurement time')
# show every 5th x-tick label to avoid crowding
ticks = ax.get_xticks()
labels = [l.get_text() for l in ax.get_xticklabels()]
ax.set_xticks(ticks[::5])
ax.set_xticklabels(labels[::5], rotation=45, ha='right')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('measurements_by_time.png', bbox_inches='tight')
plt.show()

In [10]:

sns.violinplot(

plt.savefig('monthly_violin.png', bbox_inches='tight')
plt.show()

6b – Box plot¶

In [11]:
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(14, 5))

month_colors = sns.color_palette('coolwarm', 12)
bp = ax.boxplot(
    [df_filtered[df_filtered['month'] == m]['temp'].values for m in range(1, 13)],
    patch_artist=True,
    medianprops=dict(color='black', linewidth=1.5),
    whiskerprops=dict(linewidth=0.9),
    capprops=dict(linewidth=0.9),
    flierprops=dict(marker='o', markersize=1.5, alpha=0.3, linestyle='none'),
    showfliers=True
)
for patch, color in zip(bp['boxes'], month_colors):
    patch.set_facecolor(color)
    patch.set_alpha(0.8)

ax.set_xticks(range(1, 13))
ax.set_xticklabels(MONTH_NAMES)
ax.set_xlabel('Month')
ax.set_ylabel('Temperature (°C)')
ax.set_title('Monthly Temperature Distribution – Box Plot\n(reference stations, 1960–2020, times 12 & 14)')
ax.axhline(0, color='black', linewidth=0.7, linestyle='--', alpha=0.6)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('monthly_boxplot.png', bbox_inches='tight')
plt.show()

6c – Mean ± 1 std ribbon with jittered strip¶

In [12]:
monthly_stats = (
    df_filtered.groupby('month')['temp']
               .agg(['mean', 'std', 'median'])
               .reset_index()
)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 5))

ax.fill_between(
    monthly_stats['month'],
    monthly_stats['mean'] - monthly_stats['std'],
    monthly_stats['mean'] + monthly_stats['std'],
    alpha=0.25, color='steelblue', label='Mean ± 1 std'
)
ax.plot(monthly_stats['month'], monthly_stats['mean'],
        'o-', color='steelblue', linewidth=2, label='Mean', zorder=3)
ax.plot(monthly_stats['month'], monthly_stats['median'],
        's--', color='darkorange', linewidth=1.5, label='Median', zorder=3)

ax.set_xticks(range(1, 13))
ax.set_xticklabels(MONTH_NAMES)
ax.set_xlabel('Month')
ax.set_ylabel('Temperature (°C)')
ax.set_title('Monthly Temperature – Mean, Median and Spread\n(reference stations, 1960–2020, times 12 & 14)')
ax.axhline(0, color='black', linewidth=0.7, linestyle='--', alpha=0.6)
ax.legend()
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('monthly_ribbon.png', bbox_inches='tight')
plt.show()

Task 7 – Long-Term Temperature Trend (1960–2020)¶

7a – All months combined: yearly mean with linear trend¶

In [13]:
yearly_mean = (
    df_filtered.groupby('year')['temp']
               .agg(mean='mean', std='std', median='median',
                    q25=lambda x: x.quantile(0.25),
                    q75=lambda x: x.quantile(0.75))
               .reset_index()
)

# OLS linear regression for trend line
slope, intercept, r, p, se = stats.linregress(yearly_mean['year'], yearly_mean['mean'])
trend_y = slope * yearly_mean['year'] + intercept

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(14, 5))

ax.fill_between(yearly_mean['year'],
                yearly_mean['q25'], yearly_mean['q75'],
                alpha=0.20, color='steelblue', label='IQR (Q25–Q75)')
ax.fill_between(yearly_mean['year'],
                yearly_mean['mean'] - yearly_mean['std'],
                yearly_mean['mean'] + yearly_mean['std'],
                alpha=0.15, color='steelblue', label='Mean ± 1 std')
ax.plot(yearly_mean['year'], yearly_mean['mean'],
        'o-', color='steelblue', markersize=4, linewidth=1.4, label='Annual mean')
ax.plot(yearly_mean['year'], trend_y,
        color='crimson', linewidth=2, linestyle='--',
        label=f'Linear trend  ({slope*10:+.3f} °C / decade,  R²={r**2:.2f})')

ax.set_xlabel('Year')
ax.set_ylabel('Temperature (°C)')
ax.set_title('Long-Term Annual Temperature Trend – All Months\n(reference stations, times 12 & 14)')
ax.legend()
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('trend_all_months.png', bbox_inches='tight')
plt.show()

print(f"Linear trend: {slope*10:+.4f} °C per decade   (p = {p:.4f})")

Linear trend: +0.3206 °C per decade   (p = 0.0000)

7b – Selected month (June = 6): yearly mean with linear trend¶

In [14]:
SELECTED_MONTH = 6  # change as desired

df_month = df_filtered[df_filtered['month'] == SELECTED_MONTH]

yearly_mean_month = (
    df_month.groupby('year')['temp']
            .agg(mean='mean', std='std',
                 q25=lambda x: x.quantile(0.25),
                 q75=lambda x: x.quantile(0.75))
            .reset_index()
)

slope_m, intercept_m, r_m, p_m, _ = stats.linregress(
    yearly_mean_month['year'], yearly_mean_month['mean']
)
trend_y_m = slope_m * yearly_mean_month['year'] + intercept_m

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(14, 5))

ax.fill_between(yearly_mean_month['year'],
                yearly_mean_month['q25'], yearly_mean_month['q75'],
                alpha=0.20, color='darkorange', label='IQR (Q25–Q75)')
ax.fill_between(yearly_mean_month['year'],
                yearly_mean_month['mean'] - yearly_mean_month['std'],
                yearly_mean_month['mean'] + yearly_mean_month['std'],
                alpha=0.15, color='darkorange', label='Mean ± 1 std')
ax.plot(yearly_mean_month['year'], yearly_mean_month['mean'],
        'o-', color='darkorange', markersize=4, linewidth=1.4,
        label=f'{MONTH_NAMES[SELECTED_MONTH-1]} annual mean')
ax.plot(yearly_mean_month['year'], trend_y_m,
        color='crimson', linewidth=2, linestyle='--',
        label=f'Linear trend  ({slope_m*10:+.3f} °C / decade,  R²={r_m**2:.2f})')

ax.set_xlabel('Year')
ax.set_ylabel('Temperature (°C)')
ax.set_title(f'Long-Term Temperature Trend – {MONTH_NAMES[SELECTED_MONTH-1]} only\n'
             f'(reference stations, times 12 & 14)')
ax.legend()
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig(f'trend_month_{SELECTED_MONTH}.png', bbox_inches='tight')
plt.show()

print(f"Linear trend ({MONTH_NAMES[SELECTED_MONTH-1]}): {slope_m*10:+.4f} °C per decade   (p = {p_m:.4f})")

Linear trend (Jun): +0.2614 °C per decade   (p = 0.0200)

7c – Heatmap: all 12 months over all years (split-apply-combine)¶

In [15]:
pivot = (
    df_filtered.groupby(['year', 'month'])['temp']
               .mean()
               .unstack('month')
)
pivot.columns = MONTH_NAMES

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(14, 10))
sns.heatmap(
    pivot,
    cmap='RdBu_r',
    center=0,
    linewidths=0,
    yticklabels=5,
    cbar_kws={'label': 'Mean temperature (°C)', 'shrink': 0.6},
    ax=ax
)
ax.set_xlabel('Month')
ax.set_ylabel('Year')
ax.set_title('Mean Monthly Temperature Heatmap (1960–2020)\n(reference stations, times 12 & 14)')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('heatmap_monthly_yearly.png', bbox_inches='tight')
plt.show()
